outcome: Presence of at least one high-quality embryo during transplantation
Proportions of very low birth weight
Incidences of small for gestational age
Incidence of single live births larger than gestational age
cohort: The study included patients who achieved live births through IVF/ICSI-ET at the Reproductive Medicine Center of Jiangxi Maternal and Child Health Hospital from September 2021 to May 2023, specifically those undergoing fresh embryo transfers during the early follicular phase prolonged protocol.
finding: Painless oocyte retrieval did not significantly affect oocyte fertilization, follicular maturation, cleavage, clinical pregnancy rates, or the risk of maternal complications and birth defects, with the exception of a statistically significant increase in the incidence of single live births larger than gestational age.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in cesarean section rates between the painless oocyte retrieval and conventional oocyte retrieval groups.
